title: Algebraization of a principal-adic finite-type quotient tower
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $a\in A$. For each $m\geq1$ let $C_m$ be a finite type commutative $A/(a^m)$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], with $A$-algebra transition maps $t_m:C_m\to C_{m-1}$ for $m\geq2$. Assume that each $t_m$ induces an isomorphism $C_m/a^{m-1}C_m\xrightarrow{\sim}C_{m-1}$. Then $F=\varprojlim_{m\geq1}C_m$, with componentwise ring operations, is an $(a)$-adically complete Noetherian $A$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. For every $m$, its coordinate projection induces an $A$-algebra isomorphism $F/a^mF\xrightarrow{\sim}C_m$, compatible with transitions. There are $q\geq0$ and an ideal $Q$ of $\widehat{A[z_1,\ldots,z_q]}_{(a)}$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] with an $A$-algebra isomorphism $F\cong\widehat{A[z_1,\ldots,z_q]}_{(a)}/Q$.
